zh: 账号菜单缩到 200px。原先展开态跟着账号行宽走（约 264px），折叠态固定 220px，两种状态都比卡片里最长的文字宽出一大截，右半边空着；现在统一取「账号行宽」与 200px 中的小者，折叠态固定 200px，卡片右边只留下本该有的内边距。
en: The account menu is 200px wide. In the wide sidebar it used to follow the account row's width (about 264px) and in the rail it was a fixed 220px, both well past the longest label in the card and leaving the right half empty; the width is now the smaller of the row width and 200px, and the rail's card is a flat 200px, so only the padding the card is supposed to have remains on the right.
